description: Implement Flutter mobile app (iOS/Android) with Firebase Auth, user onboarding (signup/login), contacts management, and 1-to-1 voice call UI/UX. Screens: Splash, Signup, Login, Contacts list, Add Contact, Outgoing Call, Incoming Call, In-Call (with mute/speaker/end), Call History, Settings. Uses flutter_webrtc for peer connection and socket_io_client for signaling.
steps: Create /apps/mobile/lib/models/: User, Contact, Call, CallState Dart classes representing Firestore data and in-memory call state
Create /apps/mobile/lib/services/auth_service.dart: Firebase Auth wrapper (signup, login, logout, getCurrentUser, getIdToken); exports Stream<User?> for listening to auth state changes

Create /apps/mobile/lib/services/firestore_service.dart: Firestore CRUD wrappers for users, contacts, calls collections; methods: createUser, getUser, searchUser, listContacts, addContact, respondContact, getCallHistory

Create /apps/mobile/lib/services/socket_service.dart: Socket.io client connecting to signaling server; event handlers for call:incoming, call:accepted, call:rejected, call:ended, webrtc:offer/answer/ice, presence:update; exports socket.emit wrappers for auth, call:request, call:accept, etc.

Create /apps/mobile/lib/services/webrtc_service.dart: flutter_webrtc RTCPeerConnection wrapper; methods: createPeerConnection, createOffer, setLocalDescription, createAnswer, addIceCandidate, onLocalStream, onRemoteStream, close; handles audio track acquisition (getUserMedia audio:true)

Create /apps/mobile/lib/services/notification_service.dart: FCM setup and handler; receives incoming call push, wakes app, routes to IncomingCallScreen; scaffold APNs handler with comment 'requires CallKit integration'
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/splash_screen.dart: Logo, loading indicator, checks Firebase auth state, navigates to Login or HomeScreen
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/signup_screen.dart: Email, password, username inputs; live availability check via POST /api/users/username; Firebase Auth signup; saves user profile to Firestore
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/login_screen.dart: Email, password inputs; Firebase Auth login; navigates to HomeScreen on success

Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/home_screen.dart: Bottom navigation with Contacts, History, Settings tabs; Contacts tab shows list of accepted contacts with online indicator, search bar, Add Contact button
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/add_contact_screen.dart: Search input for username, tap result to send contact request, request appears in their inbox (pending contact status)
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/outgoing_call_screen.dart: Shows callee name, 'Calling...' status, 30-second timeout, End button; listens for call:accepted or call:rejected events

Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/incoming_call_screen.dart: Shows caller name, Accept (green button) and Reject (red button); displayed even when app is backgrounded (via notification), Accept navigates to in-call screen

Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/in_call_screen.dart: Timer showing call duration, remote audio visualizer, Mute toggle button, Speaker toggle button, End button; displays reconnecting state if connection drops
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/call_history_screen.dart: List of past calls with call status icon (missed red dot, incoming arrow, outgoing arrow), contact name, timestamp; tap to call back
Create /apps/mobile/lib/screens/settings_screen.dart: Profile section (username, email read-only, logout button), Notifications toggle, blocked users list, About section

Create /apps/mobile/lib/providers/ or /apps/mobile/lib/state: State management using Provider package; CallProvider (current call state, call history), AuthProvider (auth state, user profile), ContactsProvider (contacts list, pending requests), SocketProvider (socket connection state)
Create /apps/mobile/pubspec.yaml with all dependencies listed in FEAT-001 step; add additional: flutter_localizations, intl for internationalization (optional for MVP)
Create /apps/mobile/lib/main.dart: MultiProvider setup, Firebase.initialize(), route configuration (MaterialApp with named routes), theme (Material Design 3 light/dark)
Implement permission request flow: request microphone permission at first call attempt, show explanation dialog if denied; use permission_handler package
Add call state machine logic: listen to Socket.io call events, update CallProvider state (calling, ringing, connected, reconnecting, ended), update UI accordingly
Implement network quality indicator in in-call screen: subscribe to WebRTC connection stats (RTCStatsReport), display signal strength based on available bitrate and packet loss
acceptance_criteria: Firebase Auth signup/login works: valid email/password creates account, duplicate email rejected, username stored in Firestore users collection
Contacts workflow: search user by username, send request, request appears as pending contact on recipient, recipient can accept/decline, only accepted contacts appear in contacts list
Call setup: select contact, tap call, outgoing screen appears, 'Calling...' status shows, server receives call:request event with correct toUsername and type: 'audio'
Incoming call: callee receives call:incoming event via Socket.io, notification displayed on Android/iOS (FCM), Accept button initiates WebRTC negotiation
WebRTC negotiation: offer/answer/ICE exchange completes, audio stream flows, remote audio audible in speaker
In-call controls: Mute button toggles microphone track enabled/disabled, Speaker button toggles speaker vs earpiece, End button closes peer connection and sends call:end event
Call history: completed calls logged in Firestore calls collection with callId, callerUid, calleeUid, startedAt, answeredAt, endedAt, durationSec
Offline handling: calling offline user shows call:unavailable, incoming calls show 'Caller is offline' if connection drops before answer
Permission request: first call triggers microphone permission dialog; if denied, shows instruction to enable in Settings
Reconnection: if network drops mid-call, show 'Reconnecting...', attempt ICE restart for 10 seconds, end call with failure reason if restart fails
verification: Run: cd apps/mobile && flutter pub get — expect all packages resolved
Run: flutter devices — expect at least one Android emulator or connected device listed
Run: cd apps/mobile && flutter run — expect app to build and launch on emulator, Splash screen appears, then navigates to Login (no user signed in)
Manual test: sign up with email and unique username, verify Firestore users collection contains new user entry
Manual test: search for another test user, send contact request, switch to other device/emulator, verify pending contact appears, accept, verify both see accepted contact
Manual test: from first device, tap accepted contact, tap call button, verify Outgoing Call screen appears, tap End, verify call:request sent to server
Manual test: send call from device A to device B, accept on B, verify in-call screen appears on both, verify audio negotiation completes (no errors in console), mute button works
Manual test: during active call, switch WiFi to mobile data (toggle airplane mode), verify 'Reconnecting...' appears, wait 10 seconds, verify call either reconnects or ends gracefully
Run: cd apps/mobile && flutter test — expect unit tests pass (if any written)
Verify Firestore calls collection: inspect completed call entries, confirm callId, timestamps, durations are correct
